name: MetaPoint user contract unrestricted approve
summary: Each MetaPoint per-user contract exposes a public approve() that grants the caller an unlimited POT allowance, so an attacker can authorize itself and transferFrom the contract's entire POT balance.
notes: Direct per-user contract deployment; its 370-byte runtime is identical at deployment, immediately before the campaign, and at the exploit.

Seventeen drain receipts contain 466 unique victim-to-pool POT transfers totaling exactly 209,431.616898011367571955 POT. Those transfers produced exactly 823,417.781370262268552996 USDT from the POT/USDT pool, used here at stablecoin par as the campaign-realized value; the attacker immediately converted the same USDT quantity to 2,515.786571418808574992 WBNB.
The USD value conservatively uses campaign-realized USDT proceeds at par rather than an external pre-exploit POT mark.

This campaign drained 466 code-identical direct per-user deployments. Target-1 deterministically represents the first context executed in the earliest defect-executing transaction; the other contexts would be redundant under exact code-hash and failure-mode curve grouping.
